ctaHeading: Northcote's landscapers are ready — let's build your dream garden.
aboutText: Myrtle Landscapes has been enhancing outdoor spaces across Northcote and surrounding suburbs for years. As a local business, we understand the area's unique climate and soil, offering tailored landscaping solutions from garden design to regular maintenance. Our team is committed to delivering high-quality work that boosts your property's beauty and functionality.
servicesText: At Myrtle Landscapes, we provide comprehensive landscaping services to Northcote residents, including design, installation, and upkeep. Our expertise covers everything from lush lawns to durable hardscaping, ensuring your outdoor space thrives year-round.

services.title: Garden Design
services.desc: Crafting personalised garden layouts that suit your style and Northcote's environment, from concept to completion.

services.title: Lawn Care
services.desc: Professional lawn installation, mowing, and fertilising to keep your turf healthy and vibrant throughout the seasons.

services.title: Tree & Shrub Services
services.desc: Expert pruning and trimming of trees and shrubs to promote growth and maintain a tidy, attractive garden.

services.title: Hardscaping
services.desc: Installing pathways, retaining walls, and outdoor features that add structure and charm to your Northcote property.

services.title: Irrigation Setup
services.desc: Efficient irrigation systems designed to water your plants effectively while conserving resources in local conditions.

services.title: Seasonal Clean-ups
services.desc: Thorough garden clean-ups in spring and autumn to remove debris and prepare your space for changing weather.
